items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, I heard, Fess told me about Buddy Bowling being there...

ctx.x: Yeah, I heard, Fess told me about Buddy Bowling being there, I think.
Well, uh, the old Masonic Hall they had here at that time, uh, that was the second horse hall, that was down here on Ballette Street.
